items.title: 2 Stocks Under $50 to Keep an Eye On and 1 We Avoid

items.title: MGM Resorts (MGM) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Weigh Take Private Bid
items.summary: The fair value estimate for MGM Resorts International has shifted slightly to US$50.57 from US$49.24, giving investors an updated reference point for the stock’s long term valuation. That change sits against a backdrop of analysts clustering price targets in the low to mid US$40s and US$50s, with views split on execution risk, growth options, and the impact of the proposed US$48.30 per share take private offer from People Incorporated.
